package.description: 让 AI 帮你安全整理杂乱文件的本地应用

en-US.description: A local AI app that helps you safely organize cluttered files
en-US.longDescription:
FilePilot is a locally running AI file-organizing application that helps you sort and archive cluttered files.
It splits file organization into a confirmable workflow: scan the source, let the model draft an organizing plan, pre-check it before execution, and run it after your confirmation. Every run keeps logs and an undo entry so you can inspect results or roll back.

Core features

Turn messy folders into a confirmable organizing plan
FilePilot drafts organizing suggestions based on file names, directory structure, and the necessary content summaries. You can file items into existing directories or let it generate a new classification structure.

Check risks before moving — the AI never touches files on its own
Before files are actually moved, FilePilot shows the organizing plan and highlights potential risks such as target path conflicts, cross-disk moves, and abnormal task states. Actual file operations run only after your confirmation.

Logs after organizing, with undo
Every run records an organizing log. Afterwards you can browse the history and use the most recent undo entry to reverse the last organizing operation.

Use your own model endpoint — no hosted service lock-in
FilePilot provides no hosted model service and ships no fixed model account. Configure your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint, such as OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama, or another compatible service.

Organize multiple sources together
Multiple files and folders can be selected at once and merged into a single organizing task.

Generate more intuitive folder icons after organizing
FilePilot also ships an icon workshop that generates, previews, applies, and restores custom icons for organized folders. This feature needs an image-generation model.

zh-CN.description: 让 AI 帮你安全整理杂乱文件的本地应用
zh-CN.longDescription:
FilePilot 是一个本地运行的 AI 文件整理应用，能够帮助用户整理和归档各种杂乱文件。
它把文件整理拆成一条可确认的工作流：扫描来源 → 模型生成整理方案 → 执行前预检 → 用户确认后执行。每次执行都保留日志和回退入口，方便检查结果或撤销。

核心特性

把杂乱文件夹变成可确认的整理方案
FilePilot 可以基于文件名、目录结构和必要的内容摘要生成整理建议。你可以选择把文件归入已有目录，也可以让它生成新的分类结构。

移动前先检查风险，不让 AI 直接乱动文件
在真正移动文件之前，FilePilot 会先展示整理方案，并对潜在风险进行提示，例如目标路径冲突、跨磁盘移动、异常任务状态等。用户需要确认后才会执行实际文件操作。

整理后可查日志，操作可回退
每次执行都会记录整理日志。整理完成后，可以查看历史记录，并使用最近一次回退入口撤销上一次整理操作。

使用你自己的模型接口，不绑定托管服务
FilePilot 不提供托管模型服务，也不会内置固定模型账号。你需要自行配置 OpenAI-compatible 模型接口，例如 OpenAI、DeepSeek、Ollama 或其他兼容服务。

支持多个来源一起整理
可以同时选择多个文件或文件夹作为来源，合并到一次整理任务中一起处理。

整理后为文件夹生成更直观的图标
FilePilot 还提供图标工坊，可为整理后的文件夹生成、预览、应用和恢复自定义图标。该功能需要额外配置生图模型。
